correctness.rationale: For the exact 100 tetrahedra on 16 vertices, independent face reconstruction gives (16,116,200,100). Contracting edges (1,v) gives a 200x101 integral triangular relation matrix. Independent exact Bareiss evaluation of the specified 100x100 subminor yields -4, and the explicit primitive integral cocycle annihilates every relation; the rational rank is exactly 100. Independent mod-two elimination gives rank 98: exactly two even Smith factors with product dividing 4, forcing two factors 2,2 and H1=Z+(Z/2)^2. Enumerated 507 graph triangles, with 307 empty; computed free cocycle values and three quotient bits with free parity c0+c2 and found no zero class. Precisely 157 pure order-two carriers (55,53,49) and 150 primitive free ±1 carriers (38,38,37,37), after orientation identification. These 307 are exactly the edge-length-three integral systoles in this triangulation.
